The identical passage at D I.54 reads paṭuvā (q. v.), with vv. ll. pamuṭā, pamuvucā, while DA I.164 expls pacuṭā =gaṇṭhikā (vv. ll. pamuṭā, pamucā, papuṭā). Dial.
